extraction.videoInfoSound: {provider} receives {frames} pictures taken from this video (stored in S3 and shared by a short-lived link) and a transcript of what is said in it. aiSpend.runsNotPricedDescription: No AI prices were set in Settings when they ran, so only the usage was recorded. Prices entered later do not rewrite history.
aiSpend.someNotPricedDescription: They ran before AI prices were set in Settings, so they are not in the total.
aiSpend.noRuns: No AI runs on this lead
aiSpend.noteSurvey: Spent while this was still a sales lead, before the survey existed. Shown here so the cost of winning the job is not lost; it is reported, not re-charged.
aiSpend.noteQuotation: Spent while this was still a sales lead, before the quotation existed. Shown here so the cost of winning the job is not lost; it is reported, not re-charged.

webForm.title: Website form
webForm.description: A “request a quote” form for your website. Visitors don't sign in: each request becomes a sales lead, and they can then add photos, videos, voice notes and documents.
webForm.enabledHint: Off: the form shows “not available” and no leads are created.
webForm.accentHint: Use your website's main colour for buttons and highlights.
webForm.heading: Heading
webForm.allowUploadsHint: After sending, the visitor can add files to the lead (needs AWS storage under Settings).
webForm.showCompanyNameHint: Turn off when your website already shows it.
webForm.statusHint: Status given to every lead from the website.
webForm.sourceHint: Shown as the lead's source, e.g. Website or Facebook page.
webForm.saveFailed: We couldn't save the website form.
webForm.saveFirst: Save the form to get its address and website code.
webForm.offWarning: The form is off. Turn on “Accept requests” and save before you publish it.
webForm.linkHint: Use it for a button, an email signature or a QR code.
webForm.embedHint: Paste it where the form should appear (an HTML or “embed” block). The frame resizes itself and is allowed to use the camera and microphone for recordings.
webForm.newAddressConfirm: Give the form a new address?
webForm.newAddressHint: The current link and website code stop working. Use this if the form is being misused.
webForm.newAddressDone: The form has a new address. Update your website.
webForm.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it.
webForm.previewHint: The saved form, as visitors see it. Sending it creates a real lead.
webForm.captchaOnText: Every request must pass Cloudflare's “not a robot” check before a lead is created.
webForm.captchaOffText: Requests are only protected by the hidden trap field and rate limits. Your system administrator turns the captcha on by setting Captcha__SiteKey and Captcha__SecretKey on the server.
